items.reason: A rinse-off wash that is fine for an adult and suits a shopper who wants a clearer-looking complexion.

response.routine_note: Start with this wash once a day, rinse well, and build up slowly if your skin feels dry or tight. Because your skin is affecting your mood and your wish to go out, please talk to a dermatologist or your doctor, as they can offer support beyond what a shop can sell, so I have not added more products.
